audit.whatIsWrong: (a) THE BLIND IS ON THE WRONG ABILITY, everywhere. The page's tracked threat is literally named 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' — in focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dosFull[2], report[1], report[3], report[5], report[9] and breakdown.feeding — and the content layer repeats it as 'her E vault blinds your autos' in whys[0], whys[6], spikes[0], spikes[3], early, late and wants.foe[0]. Vault does not blind. Per Riot's text, Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) is what hinders vision; Vault (E, 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) dashes to the target, damages, slows, briefly INTERRUPTS, and leaves her at max attack range. Two different spells with two different cooldowns, and the page merges them into one button. (b) MISSING, and decisive: Vault interrupts. That is the answer to Pop Blossom's wind-up, and the whole Level 6 plan is written as if her only response were to walk away. (c) MISSING: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel — a landed Tangle-Barbs cancels her roam and her escape outright. (d) FABRICATION: whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say she kites out 'before your shields recover'. Neeko has no shield in her kit.
audit.why: Tracking one fused cooldown means the player waits out an 11s Q and steps into a live 12s E, or vice versa. And a Neeko who does not know Vault interrupts will keep spending a 120s ultimate into a 12s dash.
audit.corrected: Track two cooldowns: Blinding Assault, 1025 range and 11s at rank 1, is the nearsight; Vault, 675 range and 12s at rank 1, is the interrupt-dash that resets her spacing. Commit only when both are gone. Her ultimate is a channel your root cancels.
sources: enemyKit Q/E/R text, ranges, cooldowns and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect note says 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and sequencingCues is 0. The page repeatedly says 'bait it, count it' without ever naming a number.
audit.why: A merged, unnumbered cooldown is unusable. The two real numbers — 11s and 12s at rank 1 — are what make 'wait, then go' actionable.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and two chart rows.

edits.before: Level 6 is your one real moment. Pop Blossom plus disguise or W (Shapesplitter) invisibility means you can set the channel up unseen — if she's pinned near the wave or vaults onto you, the AoE stun catches her where her E can't save her, and a landed E into Q re-bloom into ult can delete her squishy frame. But it's feast-or-famine: if she reads the channel she just vaults out and blinds you, and you've burned everything. Through 4-5 you're shoving with Q and looking to roam, because standing in lane to duel her is a losing trade.
edits.after: Level 6 is your one real moment. Pop Blossom plus disguise or W (Shapesplitter) invisibility means you can set the wind-up unseen — pinned near the wave, the AoE stun catches her where nothing saves her, and a landed E into Q re-bloom into ult deletes her squishy frame. But it is feast-or-famine, and Vault is why: that leap interrupts, so if she reads the wind-up she cancels the ult outright. Go on its 12s downtime. Through 4-5 shove with Q and roam, because duelling her in lane is a losing trade.

edits.before: She owns the long game in this lane. Quinn out-roams and out-pokes you with her move speed, and once she's even or ahead she vaults in, blinds your whole combo, and Harrier-kites away before your shields and W reset. You don't have the range or the escape to win a stand-up fight against her. Your value is being a teamfight bomb — group, find clustered fights where your Q and Pop Blossom hit multiple bodies, and let your team answer her splitpush instead of trying to 1v1 her.

notes: This page tracked a fused ability that does not exist: 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' appears in twelve full-layer fields and seven content strings, merging Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11s) with Vault (E, 675 range, 12s). Splitting them is the single biggest improvement available here, and it also unlocks the missing decisive fact — Vault interrupts, which is what actually beats Pop Blossom. No mirror existed; quinn__neeko should be written to match. SAMPLE SIZE: brief 'games' 179, packet.games 7 at 42.86% — the chart correction rests on the whys, not the win rate. Left diff TRICKY 7/10 and carryRating 7.5/10 alone; both fit a lane Quinn owns at six of seven stages.
